name: _expand-modal.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal/_expand-modal.scss — the expand-modal body — media figure layout, genie zoom entrance/exit (modal-zoom-* keyframes), close bar/area/buttons and content panes.
//  Imported by modal.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Expand modal inner layout — media centered with genie zoom in/out (modal-zoom-* keyframes).
.#{$_B_EXPAND} {
  &-open-1 {
    @extend %RESETBTN;
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    // Animated border-corner button style (like the internal arrows)
    position: absolute;
    bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      opacity 0.2s ease;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    // The animated corner borders
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    .internal-expand:hover &,
    .internal-expand:focus & {
      color: var(--color-white-raw);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }

    // WebGPU corner-bracket overlay — the rust/corner-brackets canvas
    // repaints both L brackets once mounted inside the button; the
    // pseudo-element brackets drop out while the canvas is live.
    .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::before,
    &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::after {
      content: none;
    }
  }

  &-open-2 {
    // Hidden — open-1 is the sole expand trigger
    display: none;
  }

  &-close-bar {
    @extend %MAXAREA;
    left: 0;
    top: to-rem($space-lg);
    position: fixed;
    display: flex;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 100;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;

    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 200;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: 60%;
    }

    // Self-contained close control: <media-expanded> adopts modal.scss only,
    // so it cannot rely on preferences.scss for canvas geometry or fallback.
    .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
      @extend %RESETBTN;

      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: to-rem($space-2xl);
      height: to-rem($space-2xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      color: var(--color-white-raw);
      background: var(--border-color);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition:
        background 0.2s ease,
        transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

      .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: var(--radius-round);
        pointer-events: none;

        &.is-fallback {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      // Explicit CSS X remains authoritative until WebGL initializes and
      // returns whenever context creation/rendering fails. The adjacent-
      // sibling switch avoids relying on :has(), preserving old-browser
      // fallback behavior.
      .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: block;
        pointer-events: none;

        &::before,
        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          top: 50%;
          left: 50%;
          width: to-rem($space-lg);
          height: to-rem($space-2xs);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          background: currentColor;
          transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        }

        &::before {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
        }

        &::after {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg);
        }
      }

      .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas:not(.is-fallback) + .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback {
        display: none;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        background: var(--border-item-hover);

        .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback::before {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(135deg);
        }

        .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bar-fallback::after {
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
        }
      }
    }

    &-button {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
      position: relative;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;

      // Animated corner borders
      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.2s ease,
          height 0.2s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
        border-left: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
        border-right: to-rem(1) solid currentColor;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        color: var(--color-white-raw);

        &::before,
        &::after {
          width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
          height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        }
      }

      // WebGPU corner-bracket overlay — same rust/corner-brackets canvas
      // as -open-1; pseudo-element brackets drop out while it is live.
      .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::before,
      &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::after {
        content: none;
      }
    }
  }

  &-close-area {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  // Styled as a proper button with animated corner borders — BELOW content
  &-close-bottom {
    @extend %RESETBTN;
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    margin: to-rem($space-3xl) auto to-rem($space-xl);
    display: block;
    color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-xl);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;

    // Animated corner borders
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.2s ease,
        height 0.2s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-right: 1px solid currentColor;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      color: var(--white);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }

    // WebGPU corner-bracket overlay — same rust/corner-brackets canvas
    // as the other modal buttons; pseudos drop out while it is live.
    .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::before,
    &:has(> .#{$_B_EXPAND}-bracket-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::after {
      content: none;
    }
  }

  &-content {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-xl);
    min-height: 100vh;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    transform-origin: center top;

    // Liquid-glass veil — a translucent dark + backdrop-blur layer
    // painted behind the modal's content, so the live page stays
    // visible through the dim like frosted glass. It lives on a ::before
    // pseudo (not on content itself) so it paints independently of the
    // genie warp: the translucent tint is the FIRST thing the modal
    // renders, while the funnel carries only the bounded card over it.
    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: -1;
      // Fallback for engines without color-mix (Chrome ‹ 111): opaque
      // dark rather than transparent — the older behavior, still correct.
      background-color: var(--bg-dark);
      background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 82%, transparent);
    }

    // The backdrop blur is staged — it arrives with --glass a frame or
    // two after open. A fullscreen backdrop-filter forces the engine to
    // snapshot the whole page behind the layer before the pseudo can
    // composite at all, which is what used to delay the "transparent
    // background" first paint on weaker GPUs; keeping the blur off the
    // initial declaration lets the tint paint in the first frame and the
    // frost land right after.
    &--glass::before {
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }

    // The genie warp is the entrance — the CSS zoom only runs when JS
    // marks the content with --css-zoom (transition unavailable).
    &--css-zoom {
      animation: modal-zoom-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }
  }

  // Closing state: zoom-out animation (legacy fallback — the genie
  // collapse skips this class entirely)
  &--closing {
    transform-origin: center top;
    animation: modal-zoom-out 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) forwards;
  }

  // Genie transition surface — a fullscreen fixed canvas inside the
  // dialog's top layer that paints the media warping between the
  // origin figure and the modal box. pointer-events: none keeps every
  // close affordance reachable underneath; aria-hidden + no content.
  &-genie-canvas {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    z-index: 200;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // Veiled content while the genie overlay runs. The warp's sheet is
  // the bounded media card — reference-faithful, only the card itself
  // hard-hides because the overlay repaints it every frame. The glass
  // veil and viewport chrome (title bar, bottom close) stay painted:
  // the transparent background is the FIRST thing the modal renders and
  // the funnel flies over the live glass, exactly like the desktop
  // staying lit behind a minimizing window. Layout is preserved
  // throughout — the warp's destination rect stays measurable.
  &-genie-veil {
    .#{$_B_EXPAND}-media-figure {
      visibility: hidden;
    }
  }

  // Video-specific modal layout: max 100ch minus padding, contained vertically so close button sits below without scrolling
  &-content--video {
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    max-height: 100vh;
    max-height: 100dvh;
    padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);

    .#{$_B_EXPAND}-close-bottom {
      margin: to-rem($space-md) auto 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
  }

  &-media {
    &-figure {
      position: relative;
      display: block;
      // Preserve intrinsic media width: narrow screenshots stay pixel-sharp
      // instead of being stretched to the modal's full content width.
      width: fit-content;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: to-rem(12);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: var(--bg-dark);

      &--video {
        max-width: min(100%, calc(100ch - 4rem));
        max-height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 12rem);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        flex: 1;
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 auto;
        box-shadow: none;
        background-color: transparent;
      }

      // Loading shimmer — mirrors the media-figure contract: until the
      // media layer reports loaded (--loaded stamps on the figure), a
      // transparent SVG placeholder would leave a blank box on slow
      // networks. The sweep sits under the placeholder/item layers and
      // simply gets covered once media paints.
      &:not(&--loaded)::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          105deg,
          transparent 30%,
          var(--skel-bg-2) 45%,
          var(--skel-bg-2) 55%,
          transparent 70%
        );
        transform: translateX(-100%);
        animation: expand-modal-shimmer 1.8s linear infinite;
        will-change: transform;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
    }

    &-placeholder {
      display: block;
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &-item {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: auto;
      height: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      // No max-height on images — the mount path stamps the WASM-computed
      // box as explicit px (calcMediaBox with an unbounded height), so a
      // "huge length" capture keeps its full fitted width and overflows
      // vertically into the dialog's own scroll instead of being squashed
      // to the viewport. scale-down stays as the intrinsic-dims safety:
      // `none` when the stamped box is larger than the file, `contain`
      // when declared metadata overstates it — declared metadata larger
      // than the real bitmap can never force an upscale. Centered so a
      // mismatch letterboxes symmetrically instead of top-anchoring.
      object-fit: scale-down;
      object-position: center;

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      &--video {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 12rem);
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      }
    }
  }

  &-image {
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }

  &-video {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }
}

// ── Loading shimmer sweep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Local to this sheet — modal.scss deliberately does not import _structure,
// so the global `skeleton-shimmer` keyframes never reach <media-expanded>'s
// shadow root (keyframes do not cross the shadow boundary). The figure's
// ::before sweep references this emission; a distinct name also avoids a
// same-name duplicate in <media-figure>'s root, which bundles both sheets.
@keyframes expand-modal-shimmer {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .#{$_B_EXPAND}-media-figure::before {
    animation: none;
  }
}

// The store-driven reduced-motion flag mirrors the media query inside
// shadow DOM, where the global html.reduced-motion sweep cannot reach.
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) {
  .#{$_B_EXPAND}-media-figure::before {
    animation: none;
  }
}

// ── Zoom-in: scale up + fade from bottom ──────────────────────────────────
@keyframes modal-zoom-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.7) translateY(40px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
}

// ── Zoom-out: scale down + fade to bottom ─────────────────────────────────
@keyframes modal-zoom-out {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.7) translateY(40px);
  }
}
